welcome.subject: Welcome to LeanShot, {{name}}
welcome.body:
Hi {{name}},

Welcome to LeanShot. Here is what to do first:
  - Log your first injection (10 seconds)
  - Upload a progress photo
  - Invite your doctor to read-share

— The LeanShot team
password_reset.subject: Reset your LeanShot password
password_reset.body:
Hi {{name}},

We received a request to reset the password on your LeanShot account. Use the link below to set a new password. The link expires in 1 hour.

{{reset_url}}

If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

— The LeanShot team
payment_receipt.subject: Your LeanShot receipt — {{amount}}
payment_receipt.body:
Hi {{name}},

Thanks for your payment of {{amount}}. Your LeanShot subscription is active.

View your invoice: {{invoice_url}}

— The LeanShot team
dunning.subject: Action needed: payment failed for LeanShot
dunning.body:
Hi {{name}},

We could not process your last payment of {{amount}} for LeanShot. Please update your payment method to keep your subscription active.

{{invoice_url}}

— The LeanShot team
clinic_invite.subject: {{org_name}} invited you to share your LeanShot data
clinic_invite.body:
Hi,

{{name}} at {{org_name}} has invited you to share your LeanShot treatment data so they can support your care.

Review and accept the invitation here:
{{reset_url}}

This invitation expires in 7 days. If you were not expecting it, you can safely ignore this email.

— The LeanShot team
clinic_org_invite.subject: You have been invited to join a clinic on LeanShot
clinic_org_invite.body:
Hi,

You have been invited as a {{role}} to join {{org_name}} on LeanShot.

Accept your invitation:
{{reset_url}}

This invitation expires in 7 days.

— The LeanShot team
clinic_patient_invite.subject: You have been invited to connect with a clinic on LeanShot
clinic_patient_invite.body:
Hi,

A clinic has invited you to connect your treatment tracking on LeanShot.

Accept the invitation (expires in 14 days):
{{reset_url}}

If you did not expect this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.

— The LeanShot team
dsar_confirmation.subject: Your LeanShot data export is ready
dsar_confirmation.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your LeanShot data export is ready to download. The link below is available for 7 days.

{{reset_url}}

— The LeanShot team
lifecycle_behavior.subject: A quick LeanShot nudge, {{name}}
lifecycle_behavior.body:
Hi {{name}},

Quick check-in based on your recent activity on LeanShot. Open the app to see the latest insights:

{{reset_url}}

— The LeanShot team
